Status: New

New issue 77 by felipnu...@gmail.com: Cannot install
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=77

After Stan is installed and running properly in my computer, I tried to use
it from RStudio. But it doesn't work.

I open my Rstudio, and run the following code:

Sys.setenv(R_ARCH = '/x86_64')

library(inline)
library(Rcpp)

options(repos = c(getOption("repos"), rstan
= "http://wiki.stan.googlecode.com/git/R"))
install.packages('rstan', type = 'source')

The installation is not completed. I get the following error:

ERROR: failed to lock directory
‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library’ for
modifying
Try removing
‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/00LOCK-rstan’
Warning in install.packages :
installation of package ‘rstan’ had non-zero exit status

The downloaded source packages are in

‘/private/var/folders/sP/sPZkBLo5FYGMB2lYK3vuPE+++TI/-Tmp-/RtmpeZxcoe/downloaded_packages’

How can I solve this problem?

Thanks

messages.author: 5b11633594333711
messages.subject: Re: Issue 77 in stan: Cannot install
parts:
Comment #1 on issue 77 by goodrich...@gmail.com: Cannot install
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=77

As the error message suggests, you can try this in R

file.remove("/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/00LOCK-rstan")

and then install rstan again. See the section on "Locking" in
help(install.packages).
